name: Redis
description: In-memory data store for cache, queues, and lightweight coordination.
containerArgs: if [ -n "${REDIS_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then exec /usr/local/bin/docker-entrypoint.sh redis-server --requirepass "$REDIS_PASSWORD"; else exec /usr/local/bin/docker-entrypoint.sh redis-server; fi

values.label: Password
values.description: Optional Redis authentication password. A long, random value is recommended.
